tweets.text: During the meeting, they reviewed bilateral relations between the two countries and discussed regional developments and the efforts made in this regard.

tweets.text: The meeting was attended by His Excellency the Ambassador of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques to the Republic of Cyprus, Mr. Fawaz bin Abdul Rahman Al-Shubaili.
tweets.originalText: حضر اللقاء، سعادة سفير خادم الحرمين الشريفين لدى جمهورية قبرص الأستاذ فواز بن عبدالرحمن الشبيلي.

tweets.text: #Royal_Court: #The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and His Highness the #Crown_Prince offer their condolences to the government and people of the brotherly Republic of Yemen on the death of former President Abd Rabbuh Mansour Hadi.
tweets.originalText: #الديوان_الملكي: #خادم_الحرمين_الشريفين وسمو #ولي_العهد يعزيان حكومة وشعب الجمهورية اليمنية الشقيق في وفاة الرئيس السابق عبدربه منصور هادي.

tweets.text:
We thank God Almighty for honoring us with serving the Two Holy Mosques and caring for the pilgrims to His Sacred House. We ask God to accept from the pilgrims their Hajj, rituals, and obedience. 
With the advent of the blessed Eid Al-Adha, we congratulate our people in this blessed country and our Islamic nation on this occasion, and we pray to Him, Glory be to Him, to make it a holiday of goodness, peace and stability for our nation.
tweets.originalText:
نشكر المولى عز وجل أن شرّفنا بخدمة الحرمين الشريفين، ورعاية حجاج بيته الحرام، سائلين الله أن يتقبل من الحجاج حجهم ونسكهم وطاعاتهم. 
ومع حلول عيد الأضحى المبارك، نهنئ شعبنا في هذا الوطن المبارك وأمتنا الإسلامية بهذه المناسبة، وندعوه سبحانه أن يجعله عيد خير وسلام واستقرار على أمتنا

tweets.text:
I congratulate the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and His Highness the Crown Prince and Prime Minister - may God protect them - on the blessed Eid Al-Adha. I also congratulate the heroes of our armed forces and the participants from the sectors of the state serving the guests of God.
Asking God to grant us success in serving our religion and defending our homeland and its sanctities, and to accept from the pilgrims their Hajj, rituals, and obedience.
tweets.originalText:
